// @path: src/app/ops/page.tsx
// @expect: OPS-MEDIA-ELEMENT
// Shared definition of done item 9 had no gate behind it. Every byte of media
// in this product is a child's photograph, drawing or voice note, and an img
// tag renders one while satisfying every data rule in the gate, because the
// path arrived as an innocent-looking string on a DTO.
import { requireOperator } from "@/lib/ops/session";
import { latest } from "@/lib/ops/reads";

export default async function OpsHome() {
  await requireOperator();
  const p = await latest();
  return <img src={p.path} alt="" />;
}
